function tcpoSrcMake(kind,i){const k=kind+'|'+i;if(TCPO.src.has(k))return;tcpoOut(()=>{const cv=document.createElement('canvas');TCSHOW.poster(cv,kind,i);
 const o=document.createElement('canvas');o.width=240;o.height=360;const g=o.getContext('2d');g.imageSmoothingQuality='high';g.drawImage(cv,0,0,240,360);TCPO.src.set(k,{cv:o});TCPO.n.src++})}
function tcpoWarm(){if(TCPO.warm)return;TCPO.warm=1;let Q=[];try{Q=TCSHOW.FILMS.map((f,i)=>['film',i]).concat(TCSHOW.PLAYS.map((p,i)=>['play',i]))}catch(e){tcpoErr(e)}
 const step=()=>{if(typeof WTC!=='undefined'&&WTC&&WTC.extracting){setTimeout(step,60);return}const q=Q.shift();if(q){try{tcpoSrcMake(q[0],q[1])}catch(e){tcpoErr(e)}setTimeout(step,40);return}
  TCPO.ready=true;TCPO.warm=2;try{BLD40.clear()}catch(e){}try{wtcInvalidate()}catch(e){}};setTimeout(step,200)}
// the pictures in their sizes: in a cache of their own (LRU, 6 MB) — not in the shared one of the brands, so they never push out the brands' pictures
// (the bus ads are drawn from it in every frame) and are never pushed out by them
TCPO.pics=new Map();TCPO.picB=0;
function tcpoCached(key,w,h,fn){w=Math.max(2,Math.round(w));h=Math.max(2,Math.round(h));const k=key+'|'+w+'x'+h;let e=TCPO.pics.get(k);if(e){TCPO.pics.delete(k);TCPO.pics.set(k,e);return e}
 const cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=w;cv.height=h;fn(cv.getContext('2d'),w,h);e={cv,w,h};TCPO.pics.set(k,e);TCPO.picB+=w*h*4;TCPO.n.pics=(TCPO.n.pics||0)+1;
 while(TCPO.picB>6*1048576&&TCPO.pics.size>1){const [k0,e0]=TCPO.pics.entries().next().value;TCPO.pics.delete(k0);TCPO.picB-=e0.w*e0.h*4}return e}
function tcpoPic(kind,i,w,h){const S=tcpoSrc(kind,i);if(!S)return null;return tcpoOut(()=>tcpoCached('po|'+kind+'|'+i,TCB.bucket(Math.max(4,w)),TCB.bucket(Math.max(6,h)),(g,W,H)=>{g.imageSmoothingQuality='high';g.drawImage(S.cv,0,0,W,H)}))}
// the museum's banners: the new exhibition and the nature collection, drawn in code (a gradient, an emblem, the title, the line)
const TCPO_MUS={'תערוכה חדשה':{t:'מהים אל העיר',s:'תערוכה חדשה · איך נבנו הנמל, המסילה והשדה',a:'#0d2340',b:'#1f4f7a',c:'#f2c45a',em:'harbor'},
 'אוסף הטבע':{t:'אוסף הטבע',s:'22 מיני דגים מהאגם ומהחוף · תרמו את הדג שלכם',a:'#0c3b3a',b:'#1d7f74',c:'#bff2e0',em:'fish'}};
function tcpoBanner(key,w,h){const B=TCPO_MUS[key];return tcpoOut(()=>tcpoCached('pm|'+key,TCB.bucket(Math.max(8,w)),TCB.bucket(Math.max(8,h)),(g,W,H)=>{
 const G=g.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);G.addColorStop(0,B.b);G.addColorStop(1,B.a);g.fillStyle=G;g.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
 g.save();g.globalAlpha=.9;g.strokeStyle=B.c;g.fillStyle=B.c;g.lineWidth=Math.max(1,H*.022);const ex=W*.5,ey=H*.34,u=Math.min(W,H)*.2;
 if(B.em==='fish'){for(const [dx,dy,s] of [[-1.3,-.2,.8],[0,.1,1],[1.3,-.15,.7]]){g.save();g.translate(ex+dx*u,ey+dy*u);g.scale(s,s);g.beginPath();g.ellipse(0,0,u*.62,u*.28,0,0,6.2832);g.fill();g.beginPath();g.moveTo(u*.55,0);g.lineTo(u*.95,-u*.28);g.lineTo(u*.95,u*.28);g.closePath();g.fill();g.fillStyle=B.a;g.beginPath();g.arc(-u*.36,-u*.05,u*.06,0,6.2832);g.fill();g.restore()}
  g.globalAlpha=.5;g.beginPath();for(let x=0;x<=W;x+=W/24){const y=ey+u*.75+Math.sin(x/W*12)*u*.08;x?g.lineTo(x,y):g.moveTo(x,y)}g.stroke()}
 else{g.beginPath();g.moveTo(ex-u*1.6,ey+u*.7);g.lineTo(ex+u*1.6,ey+u*.7);g.stroke();g.fillRect(ex+u*.6,ey-u*.9,u*.14,u*1.6);g.beginPath();g.moveTo(ex+u*.67,ey-u*.85);g.lineTo(ex-u*.9,ey-u*.85);g.lineTo(ex-u*.9,ey-u*.55);g.stroke();
  g.fillRect(ex-u*1.4,ey-u*.2,u*.5,u*.9);g.fillRect(ex-u*.75,ey+u*.05,u*.4,u*.65);g.beginPath();g.arc(ex-u*.2,ey-u*.75,u*.12,0,6.2832);g.fill()}   /* the crane, the stores, the lighthouse's light */
 g.restore();g.fillStyle=B.c;g.textAlign='center';g.textBaseline='middle';g.direction='rtl';let fs=Math.max(5,Math.min(H*.2,W*.16));g.font='800 '+fs+'px "Segoe UI","Noto Sans Hebrew",Arial';
 while(fs>4&&g.measureText(B.t).width>W*.9){fs-=.5;g.font='800 '+fs+'px "Segoe UI","Noto Sans Hebrew",Arial'}g.fillText(B.t,W/2,H*.68);
 let ss=Math.max(3.5,fs*.42);g.font='600 '+ss+'px "Segoe UI","Noto Sans Hebrew",Arial';while(ss>3&&g.measureText(B.s).width>W*.94){ss-=.25;g.font='600 '+ss+'px "Segoe UI","Noto Sans Hebrew",Arial'}g.fillStyle='#f6efe0';g.fillText(B.s,W/2,H*.86);
 g.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.55)';g.lineWidth=Math.max(1,W*.012);g.strokeRect(g.lineWidth,g.lineWidth,W-2*g.lineWidth,H-2*g.lineWidth)}))}

/* ---- 1 · the cinema (d2Face 'bld03'): the three frames by the doors — the posters of the evening's films ---- */
function tcpoCinema(c,N){const X=D2X,R=X.bld03,K=X.K,y1=R[3],k=tcbrPx(c);
 TCPO_FILMS.forEach((name,j)=>{const i=tcpoIdx('film',name);if(i<0)return;const px=R[0]+12+j*22,x=px,y=y1-K*43,w=16,h=K*34,e=tcpoPic('film',i,w*k,h*k);if(!e)return;c.drawImage(e.cv,x,y,w,h);
  c.strokeStyle='rgba(242,196,90,.8)';c.lineWidth=.5;c.strokeRect(x+.25,y+.25,w-.5,h-.5);TCPO.n.cinema++;TCPO.lit.set('cin'+j,{kind:'film',i,x,y,w,h})})}
function tcpoHookCinema(){if(TCPO.hookC||typeof d2Face!=='function'||typeof D2X==='undefined')return;const f=d2Face;
 d2Face=function(c,key,N){const r=f.apply(this,arguments);if(key==='bld03'&&TCPO.on){try{tcpoCinema(c,N)}catch(e){tcpoErr(e)}}return r};TCPO.hookC=true}

/* ---- 2 · the museum (B5MUS) and the theatre (B5THEA) — inside the pictures of BLD40 (only while BLD40 makes a picture) ---- */
// the museum: each banner is a coloured rectangle and its word; the rectangle drawn just before the word is the banner — the designed banner
// goes in it, and the word is not written. The theatre: the marquee gets tonight's play; its four coloured rectangles (the poster places) get the
// four plays, from tonight's on, each in a dark light box of the rectangle's size (the poster's own shape inside). Each place is kept in the picture's
// units and, when the picture is made, put in the world by every building of that type and turn (for the night).
const TCPO_MARQ='הערב: המופע החדש',TCPO_SLOT={'#c0392b':0,'#7e57c2':1,'#2f6bb0':2,'#e67e22':3};
function tcpoTonight(){try{const P=TCSHOW.PLAYS;if(!P.length)return -1;let d=1;try{d=gameClock().day}catch(e){}return((d-1)%P.length+P.length)%P.length}catch(e){return -1}}   /* a play a day — by the day of the game clock (stadium 17.11; before: the real date, Date.now) */
function tcpoMark(g,key,q,x,y,w,h){const m=g.getTransform();TCPO.mk.marks.push(Object.assign({key,dx:m.a*x+m.c*y+m.e,dy:m.b*x+m.d*y+m.f,dw:w*m.a,dh:h*m.d},q))}
function tcpoPlayBox(g,j,x,y,w,h){const k=tcbrPx(g),ph=h-1.2,pw=Math.min(w-1.2,ph/1.5),px=x+(w-pw)/2,py=y+.6,e=tcpoPic('play',j,pw*k,ph*k);if(!e)throw new Error('no source');
 g.fillStyle='#17181c';g.fillRect(x,y,w,h);g.drawImage(e.cv,px,py,pw,ph);g.strokeStyle='rgba(242,196,90,.85)';g.lineWidth=.35;g.strokeRect(px,py,pw,ph);return [px,py,pw,ph]}
function tcpoCtx(g){if(g.__tcpo)return;g.__tcpo=1;const fr0=g.fillRect,ft0=g.fillText;let last=null;
 g.fillRect=function(x,y,w,h){const M=TCPO.mk;if(!M)return fr0.apply(this,arguments);const col=String(this.fillStyle).toLowerCase();
  if(M.id==='B5THEA'&&TCPO.on&&TCPO.ready&&TCPO_SLOT[col]!=null&&Math.abs(w-10)<.01){try{const n=TCSHOW.PLAYS.length,t=Math.max(0,tcpoTonight());if(n){const j=(t+TCPO_SLOT[col])%n,r=tcpoPlayBox(this,j,x,y,w,h);tcpoMark(this,'thea'+TCPO_SLOT[col],{kind:'play',i:j},...r);TCPO.n.theatre++;return}}catch(e){tcpoErr(e)}}
  last={x,y,w,h,col};return fr0.apply(this,arguments)};
 g.fillText=function(t,x,y){const M=TCPO.mk;if(!M||!TCPO.on)return ft0.apply(this,arguments);try{
   if(M.id==='B5MUS'&&TCPO_MUS[t]&&last&&(last.col==='#7a2335'||last.col==='#2f4a6a')){const k=tcbrPx(this),e=tcpoBanner(t,last.w*k,last.h*k);this.drawImage(e.cv,last.x,last.y,last.w,last.h);tcpoMark(this,'mus'+(last.col==='#7a2335'?0:1),{kind:'banner',b:t},last.x,last.y,last.w,last.h);TCPO.n.museum++;return}
   if(M.id==='B5THEA'&&t===TCPO_MARQ){const i=tcpoTonight(),P=i>=0?TCSHOW.PLAYS[i]:null;return ft0.call(this,P?'הערב: '+P.name:t,x,y)}}catch(e){tcpoErr(e)}
   return ft0.apply(this,arguments)}}
// the places of a picture in the world: world = the building's (x, drawY) + the picture's units (BLD40.draw puts the picture at x − ox, y − oy)
function tcpoPlace(M,e){const L=new Set();for(const A of [typeof B4_BUILDINGS!=='undefined'?B4_BUILDINGS:[],typeof C4_BUILDINGS!=='undefined'?C4_BUILDINGS:[],typeof B5_BUILDINGS!=='undefined'?B5_BUILDINGS:[]])for(const o of A)L.add(o);
 for(const o of L){const b=o&&o.bld40;if(!b||b.type!==M.id||((b.rot|0)!==(M.rot|0)))continue;const X=o.x,Y=o.drawY!=null?o.drawY:o.y;
  for(const q of M.marks){const r=e.res||1;TCPO.lit.set(o.id+'|'+q.key,{kind:q.kind,i:q.i,b:q.b,x:X+q.dx/r-e.ox,y:Y+q.dy/r-e.oy,w:q.dw/r,h:q.dh/r})}}}
function tcpoHookB4(){if(TCPO.hookB||typeof BLD40==='undefined'||!BLD40||typeof BLD40.make!=='function')return;

  try{e=mk.apply(this,arguments)}finally{TCPO.mk=null}try{if(M.marks.length)tcpoPlace(M,e)}catch(err){tcpoErr(err)}return e};
 try{BLD40.clear()}catch(e){}TCPO.hookB=true}

/* ---- 3 · at night: the posters and the banners lit (after the night layer, in their place in the world) ---- */
function tcpoNight(){const d=tcbrDark();if(d<=.05||!(typeof WLD!=='undefined'&&WLD.on)||!TCPO.lit.size||!TCPO.on)return;const a=Math.min(.95,d*1.05),k=tcbrPx(ctx);let x0=-1e9,x1=1e9,y0=-1e9,y1=1e9;

 for(const q of TCPO.lit.values()){if(q.x+q.w<x0||q.x>x1||q.y+q.h<y0||q.y>y1)continue;const e=q.kind==='banner'?tcpoBanner(q.b,q.w*k,q.h*k):tcpoPic(q.kind,q.i,q.w*k,q.h*k);if(!e)continue;ctx.globalAlpha=a*.25;ctx.fillStyle='#fff1cf';ctx.fillRect(q.x-1.5,q.y-1.5,q.w+3,q.h+3);ctx.globalAlpha=a;ctx.drawImage(e.cv,q.x,q.y,q.w,q.h);TCPO.n.lit++}
 ctx.restore()}

var ALPHABET="#$%&'()*+,-./0123456789:;=?@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[]^_`abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{|}~",LOOKUP={};
for(var ai=0;ai<ALPHABET.length;ai++)LOOKUP[ALPHABET.charAt(ai)]=ai;
function readInt(code,state){var n=0,mul=1,v;do{v=LOOKUP[code.charAt(state.i++)];if(v===undefined)throw Error('Invalid drawing coordinates');n+=(v%44)*mul;mul*=44}while(v>=44);return n}
function drawPart(ctx,part,x,y,width,height){
if(!part)throw Error('Drawing format not found');
x=x||0;y=y||0;width=width===undefined?part.w:width;height=height===undefined?part.h:height;
ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.scale(width/part.w,height/part.h);
for(var i=0;i<part.layers.length;i++){var layer=part.layers[i],code=layer[1],state={i:0},position=0;ctx.fillStyle=layer[0];
while(state.i<code.length){position+=readInt(code,state);var rw=readInt(code,state)+1,rh=readInt(code,state)+1;ctx.fillRect(position%part.w,Math.floor(position/part.w),rw,rh)}}ctx.restore();}

var TCCITY={ok:function(){return true},camFor:function(){return{}},view:function(c,key,cam,v,w,h){var p=BACKDROPS[key];if(!p)throw Error('World scene not captured: '+key);drawPart(c,p,0,0,w,h);return true}};
var TCK=(function(){
 const TAU=Math.PI*2,cl=(v,a,b)=>v<a?a:v>b?b:v,lerp=(a,b,u)=>a+(b-a)*u,sm=u=>{u=cl(u,0,1);return u*u*(3-2*u)},seg=(t,a,b)=>cl((t-a)/(b-a),0,1),eio=u=>{u=cl(u,0,1);return u<.5?4*u*u*u:1-Math.pow(-2*u+2,3)/2};
 const HX={};function hx(h){if(HX[h])return HX[h];let s=String(h).replace('#','');if(s.length===3)s=s.split('').map(q=>q+q).join('');const n=parseInt(s.slice(0,6),16)||0;return HX[h]=[n>>16&255,n>>8&255,n&255]}
 function mix(a,b,u){const A=hx(a),B=hx(b);u=cl(u,0,1);return'#'+A.map((v,i)=>Math.round(v+(B[i]-v)*u).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('')}
 function rgba(h,a){const A=hx(h);return'rgba('+A[0]+','+A[1]+','+A[2]+','+cl(a,0,1).toFixed(3)+')'}
 function rng(seed){let s=(seed>>>0)||1;return()=>{s=(Math.imul(s,1664525)+1013904223)>>>0;return s/4294967296}}
 /* keyframes [[t,v1,v2..],..] → values (smooth between keys) */
 function kf(keys,t,ease){ease=ease||sm;if(t<=keys[0][0])return keys[0].slice(1);for(let i=0;i<keys.length-1;i++){const a=keys[i],b=keys[i+1];if(t<b[0]){const u=ease((t-a[0])/(b[0]-a[0]));return a.slice(1).map((v,j)=>typeof v==='string'?mix(v,b[j+1],u):lerp(v,b[j+1],u))}}return keys[keys.length-1].slice(1)}
 /* a walker: keys [[t,x,y],..] → {x,y,moving,dir,ph} — the phase of the step comes from the distance walked */
 function walker(keys,stride){stride=stride||46;const segs=[];let acc=0;for(let i=0;i<keys.length-1;i++){const a=keys[i],b=keys[i+1],d=Math.hypot(b[1]-a[1],(b[2]||0)-(a[2]||0));segs.push({a,b,d,acc});acc+=d}
  return t=>{if(t<=keys[0][0])return{x:keys[0][1],y:keys[0][2]||0,moving:0,dir:0,ph:0};for(const q of segs){if(t<q.b[0]){const u0=(t-q.a[0])/(q.b[0]-q.a[0]),u=lerp(u0,sm(u0),.55),x=lerp(q.a[1],q.b[1],u),y=lerp(q.a[2]||0,q.b[2]||0,u);return{x,y,moving:q.d>1?1:0,dir:Math.sign(q.b[1]-q.a[1]),ph:(q.acc+q.d*u)/stride}}}const L=keys[keys.length-1];return{x:L[1],y:L[2]||0,moving:0,dir:0,ph:acc/stride}}}
 const cache={};function cached(key,w,h,fn){let cv=cache[key];if(!cv){cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=Math.max(1,Math.round(w));cv.height=Math.max(1,Math.round(h));fn(cv.getContext('2d'),cv.width,cv.height);cache[key]=cv}return cv}
 /* ---------- the sky ---------- */
 const SKY=[[0,'#03061a','#0a1436','#1a2652'],[4.6,'#070c2a','#1e2350','#3e3566'],[5.6,'#1d2a5e','#6a5a8c','#f0a07a'],[6.6,'#3d6fb0','#9ec1de','#ffd7a0'],[8.5,'#3a86d6','#86bfea','#d6ecf8'],[16,'#3a82d0','#8cc2ea','#e0eef6'],[17.6,'#3a64a8','#d79a72','#ffd08a'],[18.6,'#2a3c78','#c0607a','#ff9a5a'],[19.4,'#141c48','#55406e','#d0705c'],[20.4,'#070d2c','#18224a','#363a62'],[24,'#03061a','#0a1436','#1a2652']];
 const STORM=['#15191f','#252b35','#39414d'];
 function skyCols(h,storm){h=((h%24)+24)%24;let a=SKY[0],b=SKY[1];for(let i=0;i<SKY.length-1;i++)if(h>=SKY[i][0]&&h<=SKY[i+1][0]){a=SKY[i];b=SKY[i+1];break}const u=sm((h-a[0])/(b[0]-a[0]||1));let r=[1,2,3].map(j=>mix(a[j],b[j],u));if(storm)r=r.map((q,j)=>mix(q,STORM[j],storm));return r}
 function sky(c,x,y,w,h,hour,storm){const C=skyCols(hour,storm),g=c.createLinearGradient(0,y,0,y+h);g.addColorStop(0,C[0]);g.addColorStop(.55,C[1]);g.addColorStop(1,C[2]);c.fillStyle=g;c.fillRect(x,y,w,h);return C}
 function dark(hour){const h=((hour%24)+24)%24;return h<5?1:h<7?1-(h-5)/2:h<17.5?0:h<20.5?(h-17.5)/3:1}
 function glow(c,x,y,r,col,a){if(a<=0||r<=0)return;const g=c.createRadialGradient(x,y,0,x,y,r);g.addColorStop(0,rgba(col,a));g.addColorStop(.35,rgba(col,a*.45));g.addColorStop(1,rgba(col,0));c.fillStyle=g;c.fillRect(x-r,y-r,r*2,r*2)}
 function sun(c,x,y,r,hour){const low=cl(1-Math.abs(((hour||12)-12))/6.5,0,1),col=mix('#ff7a3a','#fff3c4',low);glow(c,x,y,r*7,mix('#ff9a4a','#fff0b0',low),.45);glow(c,x,y,r*2.4,col,.8);c.fillStyle=mix(col,'#ffffff',.35);c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,r,0,TAU);c.fill()}
 function moon(c,x,y,r,a){a=a==null?1:a;glow(c,x,y,r*6,'#c8d8ff',.22*a);c.fillStyle=rgba('#f2efe0',a);c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,r,0,TAU);c.fill();c.fillStyle=rgba('#c9c4b0',.5*a);for(const [dx,dy,rr] of [[-.3,-.2,.22],[.25,.15,.16],[.05,.42,.12],[.4,-.35,.1]]){c.beginPath();c.arc(x+dx*r,y+dy*r,rr*r,0,TAU);c.fill()}}
 function stars(c,x,y,w,h,t,a,seed){if(a<=.02)return;const r=rng(seed||7),n=Math.round(w*h/2600);for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const sx=x+r()*w,sy=y+r()*h*(r()<.7?.6:1),b=r(),tw=.6+.4*Math.sin(t*(1+b*3)+i);c.fillStyle=rgba('#ffffff',a*(.3+.7*b)*tw*(1-(sy-y)/h*.6));const z=b>.93?2.2:b>.7?1.5:1;c.fillRect(sx,sy,z,z)}}
 /* a cloud: a cached soft shape, drawn at a scale, tinted by the light of the hour */
 function cloudCanvas(seed,col,shade){return cached('cl|'+seed+'|'+col+'|'+shade,360,170,(g,w,h)=>{const r=rng(seed);const pts=[];for(let i=0;i<11;i++){const u=i/10;pts.push([40+u*280+(r()-.5)*30,110-Math.sin(u*Math.PI)*(30+r()*40)-r()*12,26+Math.sin(u*Math.PI)*34+r()*14])}
  for(const [px,py,pr] of pts){const gr=g.createRadialGradient(px,py-pr*.3,pr*.1,px,py,pr);gr.addColorStop(0,col);gr.addColorStop(.7,mix(col,shade,.35));gr.addColorStop(1,rgba(mix(col,shade,.6),0));g.fillStyle=gr;g.beginPath();g.arc(px,py,pr,0,TAU);g.fill()}
  const b=g.createLinearGradient(0,60,0,150);b.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');b.addColorStop(1,rgba(shade,.45));g.globalCompositeOperation='source-atop';g.fillStyle=b;g.fillRect(0,0,w,h)})}
 function cloud(c,x,y,s,seed,col,shade,a){const cv=cloudCanvas(seed,col,shade);c.globalAlpha=a==null?1:a;c.drawImage(cv,x-180*s,y-110*s,360*s,170*s);c.globalAlpha=1}
 function clouds(c,t,o){/* o:{x,w,y,n,sp,s,col,shade,a,seed,dy} */const r=rng(o.seed||3);for(let i=0;i<o.n;i++){const sp=(o.sp||8)*(.6+r()*.8),s=(o.s||1)*(.6+r()*.7),span=o.w+500*s,x=o.x-250*s+(((r()*span+t*sp)%span)+span)%span,y=o.y+r()*(o.dy||60);cloud(c,x,y,s,(o.seed||3)*31+i%5,o.col||'#ffffff',o.shade||'#9aa7b8',o.a==null?.95:o.a)}}
 /* ---------- the sea ---------- */
 function sea(c,x,y,w,h,t,o){o=o||{};const g=c.createLinearGradient(0,y,0,y+h);g.addColorStop(0,o.top||'#2a6f97');g.addColorStop(1,o.bot||'#0b3d5c');c.fillStyle=g;c.fillRect(x,y,w,h);
  const rough=o.rough||1,n=o.lines||22;c.lineWidth=1.2;for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const u=i/n,yy=y+Math.pow(u,1.6)*h,amp=(1+u*6)*rough,len=40+u*160,sp=(.6+u)*(o.sp||1);c.strokeStyle=rgba(o.line||'#ffffff',(.08+u*.14)*(o.la||1));c.beginPath();for(let xx=x;xx<=x+w;xx+=12){const yv=yy+Math.sin(xx/len+t*sp+i*1.7)*amp*.5;xx===x?c.moveTo(xx,yv):c.lineTo(xx,yv)}c.stroke()}
  if(o.sunX!=null){const gx=o.sunX;for(let i=0;i<26;i++){const u=i/26,yy=y+Math.pow(u,1.4)*h,ww=(10+u*120)*(o.gw||1)*(.5+.5*Math.sin(t*2+i*2.3));c.fillStyle=rgba(o.glit||'#ffd27a',(.5-u*.35)*(o.ga==null?1:o.ga));c.fillRect(gx-ww/2+Math.sin(t+i)*6,yy,ww,1.6+u*3)}}}
 function waveBand(c,x0,x1,y,amp,len,ph,col,depth){c.fillStyle=col;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x0,y+depth);for(let x=x0;x<=x1;x+=8)c.lineTo(x,y+Math.sin(x/len+ph)*amp+Math.sin(x/(len*.43)+ph*1.7)*amp*.3);c.lineTo(x1,y+depth);c.closePath();c.fill()}
 /* ---------- a city skyline (cached), with lit windows at night ---------- */
 function skyline(c,x,y,w,h,seed,col,lit,winCol){const cv=cached('sk|'+seed+'|'+col+'|'+w+'|'+h+'|'+(lit>0?1:0)+'|'+winCol,w,h,(g,W,H)=>{const r=rng(seed);let px=0;while(px<W){const bw=26+r()*70,bh=H*(.25+r()*.7);g.fillStyle=col;g.fillRect(px,H-bh,bw,bh);if(r()<.25){g.fillRect(px+bw*.4,H-bh-12-r()*20,3,20)}if(r()<.2){g.beginPath();g.moveTo(px,H-bh);g.lineTo(px+bw/2,H-bh-10-r()*14);g.lineTo(px+bw,H-bh);g.fill()}
   if(lit>0){for(let yy=H-bh+8;yy<H-6;yy+=11)for(let xx=px+5;xx<px+bw-6;xx+=9)if(r()<.38){g.fillStyle=rgba(winCol||'#ffd98a',.55+r()*.45);g.fillRect(xx,yy,4,6)}}px+=bw+1+r()*6}});c.drawImage(cv,x,y-h,w,h)}
 /* ---------- weather and light ---------- */
 function rain(c,t,x,y,w,h,n,ang,a){c.strokeStyle=rgba('#cfe0f0',a==null?.35:a);c.lineWidth=1.2;c.beginPath();const r=rng(99),len=16+h*.02,dx=Math.sin(ang||.2)*len,dy=Math.cos(ang||.2)*len;for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const sx=r()*w,sy=r()*h,sp=.8+r()*.6,yy=y+((sy+t*h*1.6*sp)%h),xx=x+((sx+t*w*.1*Math.sin(ang||.2)*sp)%w+w)%w;c.moveTo(xx,yy);c.lineTo(xx+dx,yy+dy)}c.stroke()}
 function bolt(c,x,y,len,seed,a){const r=rng(seed);c.strokeStyle=rgba('#eef4ff',a);c.lineWidth=2.4;c.shadowColor='#bcd0ff';c.shadowBlur=14;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x,y);let px=x,py=y;while(py<y+len){px+=(r()-.5)*36;py+=12+r()*22;c.lineTo(px,py)}c.stroke();c.shadowBlur=0}
 function flash(t,times){let f=0;for(const q of times){const d=t-q;if(d>=0&&d<.9)f=Math.max(f,d<.08?1:d<.16?.3:d<.24?.85:Math.max(0,1-(d-.24)/.6)*.5)}return f}
 function beam(c,x,y,ang,len,spread,col,a){c.save();c.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';const ex=x+Math.cos(ang)*len,ey=y+Math.sin(ang)*len,nx=-Math.sin(ang)*len*spread,ny=Math.cos(ang)*len*spread,g=c.createLinearGradient(x,y,ex,ey);g.addColorStop(0,rgba(col,a));g.addColorStop(1,rgba(col,0));c.fillStyle=g;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x,y);c.lineTo(ex+nx,ey+ny);c.lineTo(ex-nx,ey-ny);c.closePath();c.fill();c.restore()}
 function vignette(c,w,h,a){const g=c.createRadialGradient(w/2,h/2,Math.min(w,h)*.35,w/2,h/2,Math.max(w,h)*.72);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,'+a+')');c.fillStyle=g;c.fillRect(0,0,w,h)}
 function grade(c,w,h,col,a,mode){if(a<=0)return;if(mode==='soft-light'){c.fillStyle=rgba(col,a*.45);c.fillRect(0,0,w,h);return}c.save();c.globalCompositeOperation=mode||'multiply';c.fillStyle=rgba(col,a);c.fillRect(0,0,w,h);c.restore()}   /* soft-light → a light tint: the same warmth, a much cheaper blend */
 function tree(c,x,y,s,col,sway){c.save();c.translate(x,y);c.scale(s,s);c.rotate((sway||0)*.04);c.fillStyle='#4a3524';c.fillRect(-3,-40,6,40);for(const [dx,dy,r,k] of [[0,-58,24,0],[-14,-46,17,.15],[14,-46,17,.1],[0,-74,16,-.1]]){c.fillStyle=mix(col,'#000000',.2+k);c.beginPath();c.arc(dx+(sway||0)*(1+dy/-40),dy,r,0,TAU);c.fill()}c.fillStyle=rgba('#ffffff',.08);c.beginPath();c.arc(-6+(sway||0)*2,-66,12,0,TAU);c.fill();c.restore()}
 function lamp(c,x,y,s,on,col){c.save();c.translate(x,y);c.scale(s,s);c.fillStyle='#22262c';c.fillRect(-2,-90,4,90);c.fillRect(-7,-4,14,4);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-8,-90);c.lineTo(8,-90);c.lineTo(5,-100);c.lineTo(-5,-100);c.closePath();c.fill();if(on){glow(c,0,-93,60,col||'#ffd98a',.55*on);c.fillStyle=rgba('#fff3c8',on);c.fillRect(-5,-96,10,6)}c.restore()}
 function text(c,s,x,y,size,col,o){o=o||{};c.save();c.font=(o.w||800)+' '+size+'px '+(o.f||'"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif');c.textAlign=o.al||'center';c.textBaseline=o.bl||'middle';c.direction='rtl';if(o.glow){c.shadowColor=o.glow;c.shadowBlur=o.gb||18}if(o.stroke){c.lineJoin='round';c.lineWidth=o.sw||size*.16;c.strokeStyle=o.stroke;c.strokeText(s,x,y)}c.fillStyle=col;c.globalAlpha=o.a==null?1:o.a;c.fillText(s,x,y);c.restore()}
 /* ---------- the actors ---------- */
 const MAN={hr:[6.7,7.9],hy:-91.6,neck:-83.5,sy:-81,sw:11.6,wy:-53,ww:8.6,hip:-48,hw:9.2,th:24.5,sh:23.5,ua:16.5,fa:15.5,hand:2.6,limb:[6.4,5.4,7.8,6.8]};
 const BOY={hr:[8.3,9.3],hy:-88.5,neck:-78.5,sy:-76.5,sw:10.4,wy:-50,ww:8,hip:-45.5,hw:8.6,th:23,sh:22.5,ua:15,fa:14.5,hand:2.5,limb:[6,5.1,7.4,6.4]};
 const EXPR={n:[.1,.05,'n',1],smile:[.35,.15,'smile',1],grin:[.55,.25,'grin',.92],laugh:[.75,.4,'laugh',.3],sur:[1.5,1.3,'o',1.38],worry:[1.2,-.5,'worry',1.06],sad:[1.1,-.7,'frown',.9],det:[-.9,.35,'det',.86],think:[.9,-.2,'side',.95],shout:[.3,.9,'shout',1.2],proud:[.2,.4,'smile',.8],calm:[0,0,'smile',.62]};
 function ik(ax,ay,bx,by,l1,l2,sg){let dx=bx-ax,dy=by-ay,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);const mx=l1+l2-.02;if(d>mx){bx=ax+dx/d*mx;by=ay+dy/d*mx;dx=bx-ax;dy=by-ay;d=mx}if(d<.01)d=.01;const a=Math.atan2(dy,dx),A=Math.acos(cl((l1*l1+d*d-l2*l2)/(2*l1*d),-1,1)),q=a+sg*A;return[ax+Math.cos(q)*l1,ay+Math.sin(q)*l1,bx,by]}
 function limb(c,x0,y0,x1,y1,x2,y2,w1,w2,c1,c2){c.lineCap='round';c.lineJoin='round';c.strokeStyle=c1;c.lineWidth=w1;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x0,y0);c.lineTo(x1,y1);c.stroke();c.strokeStyle=c2||c1;c.lineWidth=w2;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x1,y1);c.lineTo(x2,y2);c.stroke()}
 /* arm presets → hand targets (screen-left 'a', screen-right 'b') in the figure's units */
 function armTargets(P,B,T){const pr=P.arms||'down',d=P.turn>=0?1:-1,sy=B.sy,ph=P.walk!=null?P.walk*TAU:0,sw=P.walk!=null?Math.sin(ph)*(P.run?9:5):0,o={};
  const down=[[-B.sw-2.2-sw*.2,sy+30],[B.sw+2.2+sw*.2,sy+30]];
  const set=(a,b)=>{o.a=a;o.b=b};
  switch(typeof pr==='string'?pr:'custom'){
   case'down':set([down[0][0]+sw*(P.turn||0),down[0][1]],[down[1][0]-sw*(P.turn||0),down[1][1]]);break;
   case'hips':set([-B.sw-6,sy+24],[B.sw+6,sy+24]);o.bend=1;break;
   case'wave':{const w=Math.sin(T*9)*5;set(down[0],[B.sw+12+w,sy-26]);break}
   case'wave2':{const w=Math.sin(T*9)*5;set([-B.sw-12-w,sy-26],[B.sw+12+w,sy-26]);break}
   case'up':set([-B.sw-6,sy-34],[B.sw+6,sy-34]);break;
   case'cheer':{const w=Math.sin(T*7)*4;set([-B.sw-9+w,sy-30-Math.abs(w)],[B.sw+9-w,sy-30-Math.abs(w)]);break}
   case'point':set(d>0?down[0]:[-B.sw-28,sy+2],d>0?[B.sw+28,sy+2]:down[1]);break;
   case'pointUp':set(d>0?down[0]:[-B.sw-12,sy-30],d>0?[B.sw+12,sy-30]:down[1]);break;
   case'chin':set(d>0?down[0]:[-2,B.hy+B.hr[1]*.9],d>0?[2,B.hy+B.hr[1]*.9]:down[1]);break;
   case'head':set([-B.sw+1,B.hy-B.hr[1]*.7],[B.sw-1,B.hy-B.hr[1]*.7]);break;
   case'clap':{const op=Math.abs(Math.sin(T*11))*5;set([-1.5-op,sy+15],[1.5+op,sy+15]);break}
   case'front':set([-5,sy+19],[5,sy+19]);break;
   case'hold':set([d*6-5,sy+16],[d*6+5,sy+16]);break;
   case'lantern':set(d>0?down[0]:[-B.sw-10,sy+14],d>0?[B.sw+10,sy+14]:down[1]);break;
   case'pull':{const k=Math.sin(T*3)*3;set([d*(16+k)-3,sy+20],[d*(26+k)+3,sy+17]);break}
   case'shrug':set([-B.sw-9,sy+9],[B.sw+9,sy+9]);o.bend=1;break;
   case'think':set(down[0],[3,B.hy+B.hr[1]*.95]);break;
   case'shade':set(down[0],[d*3+2,B.hy-B.hr[1]*.35]);break;
   case'crank':{const a=T*4.2;set([d*14+Math.cos(a)*5-2,sy+20+Math.sin(a)*5],[d*14+Math.cos(a)*5+2,sy+20+Math.sin(a)*5]);break}
   case'wheel':{const a=Math.sin(T*1.6)*.5;set([d*16+Math.cos(Math.PI+a)*8,sy+16+Math.sin(Math.PI+a)*8],[d*16+Math.cos(a)*8,sy+16+Math.sin(a)*8]);break}
   case'radio':set(d>0?down[0]:[-4,B.hy+B.hr[1]*.8],d>0?[4,B.hy+B.hr[1]*.8]:down[1]);break;
   case'bow':set([-4,sy+34],[4,sy+34]);break;
   case'shake':set(d>0?down[0]:[-B.sw-16,sy+20],d>0?[B.sw+16,sy+20+Math.sin(T*10)*2]:down[1]);break;
   case'give':set(d>0?down[0]:[-B.sw-18,sy+10],d>0?[B.sw+18,sy+10]:down[1]);break;
   case'row':{const a=T*3;set([d*14+Math.cos(a)*6,sy+22+Math.sin(a)*3],[d*20+Math.cos(a)*6,sy+22+Math.sin(a)*3]);break}
   default:set(pr.a||down[0],pr.b||down[1]);o.bend=pr.bend}
  return o}
 /* the figure: feet at (x,y), s pixels per unit (a man is 100 units tall), L — the look, P — the pose */
 function fig(c,x,y,s,L,P){P=P||{};const boy=!!L.boy,B=boy?BOY:MAN,T=P.t||0,turn=cl(P.turn||0,-1,1),at=Math.abs(turn),d=turn>=0?1:-1;
  c.save();c.translate(x,y);const k=s*(L.h||(boy?.8:1));c.scale(k,k*(P.sy||1));if(P.lean)c.rotate(P.lean);
  const walking=P.walk!=null,ph=walking?P.walk*TAU:0,bob=walking?-Math.abs(Math.sin(ph))*(P.run?3.2:1.7):0,yb=(P.bob||0)+bob+(P.legs==='sit'?B.th*.92:P.legs==='kneel'?B.sh*.7:0);
  const top=L.tc||'#4a6a8a',dk=mix(top,'#000000',.32),skin=L.skin||'#d9a07a',skinD=mix(skin,'#3a2010',.28),pc=L.pc||'#2e3440',pcD=mix(pc,'#000000',.3),shoe=L.shoe||'#2a1f18';
  if(P.shadow!==false){c.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.28)';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(0,0,15,3.2,0,0,TAU);c.fill()}
  /* legs */
  const hipY=B.hip+yb,legW=B.limb[2],shW=B.limb[3],long=L.pants!=='shorts';const legs=[];
  for(const i of [0,1]){const hx0=(i?1:-1)*B.hw*.48*(1-at*.3),side=i?1:-1;let fx,fy,kn=d;
   if(P.legs==='sit'){const kx=hx0+d*B.th*Math.max(.3,at)*.95;legs.push([hx0,hipY,kx,hipY+2,kx+d*1.5,0]);continue}
   if(P.legs==='kneel'){if(i===(d>0?0:1)){legs.push([hx0,hipY,hx0+d*2,hipY+B.th*.95,hx0-d*B.sh*.7,-1])}else{const kx=hx0+d*B.th*.75;legs.push([hx0,hipY,kx,hipY+B.th*.35,kx,0])}continue}
   if(walking){const sw=(P.run?.8:.4)*Math.sin(ph+(i?Math.PI:0)),lift=Math.max(0,Math.cos(ph+(i?Math.PI:0)))*(P.run?8:4.5);fx=hx0+sw*B.th*(.25+at*.95)*d*(at>.15?1:.25);fy=-lift}
   else{const sp=P.legs==='spread'?7:P.legs==='brace'?(i?9:-9)*d:0;fx=hx0*1.15+sp*side*(P.legs==='spread'?1:0)+(P.legs==='brace'?sp:0);fy=0}
   const j=ik(hx0,hipY,fx,fy,B.th,B.sh,(i?-1:1)*-d*.0+(-d));legs.push([hx0,hipY,j[0],j[1],fx,fy])}
  const order=turn>0?[0,1]:[1,0];
  for(const i of order){const q=legs[i],far=(turn>.15&&i===0)||(turn<-.15&&i===1),col=far?pcD:pc;
   if(long){limb(c,q[0],q[1],q[2],q[3],q[4],q[5]-2,legW,shW,col,col)}else{limb(c,q[0],q[1],q[2],q[3],q[4],q[5]-2,legW,shW,far?skinD:skin,far?skinD:skin);c.strokeStyle=col;c.lineWidth=legW+.6;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(q[0],q[1]);c.lineTo(lerp(q[0],q[2],.62),lerp(q[1],q[3],.62));c.stroke()}
   if(L.socks){c.strokeStyle=L.socks;c.lineWidth=shW*.9;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(lerp(q[2],q[4],.78),lerp(q[3],q[5],.78));c.lineTo(q[4],q[5]-2);c.stroke()}
   c.fillStyle=far?mix(shoe,'#000000',.3):shoe;c.beginPath();c.ellipse(q[4]+d*2.2*(.3+at),q[5]-1.6,5.2+at*1.4,2.9,0,0,TAU);c.fill();if(L.boots){c.fillRect(q[4]-3.2,q[5]-9,6.4,8)}}
  /* arms: targets, then IK */
  const AT=armTargets(P,B,T),sx=B.sw*(1-at*.28),arms=[],bw=(P.bow||0)*15;
  for(const i of [0,1]){const shx=(i?1:-1)*(sx-1.5),shy=B.sy+yb+1.5+bw,tg=i?AT.b:AT.a,tx=tg[0],ty=tg[1]+yb+bw*.6,sg=AT.bend?(i?-1:1):(i?1:-1);const j=ik(shx,shy,tx,ty,B.ua,B.fa,sg);arms.push([shx,shy,j[0],j[1],j[2],j[3]])}
  const backArm=turn>.2?0:turn<-.2?1:-1;
  const drawArm=i=>{const q=arms[i],far=i===backArm,sl=far?dk:top,sk=far?skinD:skin,short=L.top==='tee'||L.sleeves==='short';const vest=L.top==='vest'?(L.tc2||'#e9e4d8'):null,slc=vest?(far?mix(vest,'#000',.3):vest):sl;
   if(short){limb(c,q[0],q[1],q[2],q[3],q[4],q[5],B.limb[0],B.limb[1]*.9,sk,sk);c.strokeStyle=slc;c.lineWidth=B.limb[0]+.8;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(q[0],q[1]);c.lineTo(lerp(q[0],q[2],.55),lerp(q[1],q[3],.55));c.stroke()}
   else limb(c,q[0],q[1],q[2],q[3],q[4],q[5],B.limb[0],B.limb[1],slc,slc);
   if(L.gloves){c.fillStyle=L.gloves}else c.fillStyle=sk;c.beginPath();c.arc(q[4],q[5],B.hand,0,TAU);c.fill()};
  if(backArm>=0)drawArm(backArm);
  /* the torso and the clothes */
  const sY=B.sy+yb+bw,wY=B.wy+yb+bw*.45,hY=hipY,sw=sx,ww=B.ww*(1-at*.22),hw=B.hw*(1-at*.25),long2=L.top==='raincoat'||L.top==='coat'||L.top==='firecoat'?14:0;

  c.restore()}
 /* an audience seen from behind: rows of heads and shoulders, lit by the screen or the stage. React: laugh (shoulders bounce), lean (gasp), clap (hands up), stand */
 function crowd(c,W,H,o){const rows=o.rows||3,t=o.t||0,R=rng(o.seed||5),lit=o.lit||'#8899aa',la=o.la==null?.5:o.la;
  for(let r=rows-1;r>=0;r--){const y=H-(r*o.rowH||r*H*.09)-(o.base||0),sc=(o.scale||1)*(1-r*.13),n=Math.round((o.n||11)+r*2),sp=W/n;
   c.fillStyle=mix(o.seat||'#3a0a14','#050306',(o.dim||0)*.6);c.fillRect(0,y-24*sc,W,60*sc);c.fillStyle=rgba('#ffffff',.04);c.fillRect(0,y-24*sc,W,2*sc);

  c.save();c.translate(x,y-h);c.scale(Math.cos(ang),1);c.fillStyle=col;c.fillRect(-jib*.3,-6,jib*1.3,6);c.strokeStyle=col;c.lineWidth=1.4;c.beginPath();for(let k=-jib*.3;k<jib;k+=12){c.moveTo(k,-6);c.lineTo(k+6,0)}c.moveTo(0,-26);c.lineTo(jib*.9,-6);c.moveTo(0,-26);c.lineTo(-jib*.3,-6);c.stroke();c.fillStyle='#3a3e46';c.fillRect(-jib*.3,-4,26,16);c.fillStyle=K.mix('#9ad1ff','#2a3a5a',nt);c.fillRect(8,0,14,10);c.restore();
  const hx=x+jib*.75*Math.cos(ang);if(hookY!=null){c.strokeStyle='#2a2d33';c.lineWidth=1.2;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(hx,y-h);c.lineTo(hx,hookY);c.stroke();c.fillStyle='#c0392b';c.fillRect(hx-3,hookY,6,7)}return hx}
 function kite(c,x,y,s,t,col){c.save();c.translate(x,y);c.rotate(Math.sin(t*2.3)*.15);c.scale(s,s);c.fillStyle=col||'#d8452f';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(0,-26);c.lineTo(18,0);c.lineTo(0,30);c.lineTo(-18,0);c.closePath();c.fill();c.fillStyle='#f2c230';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(0,-26);c.lineTo(18,0);c.lineTo(0,0);c.closePath();c.fill();c.beginPath();c.moveTo(0,30);c.lineTo(-18,0);c.lineTo(0,0);c.closePath();c.fill();c.strokeStyle='#5a3a2a';c.lineWidth=1;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(0,30);for(let k=1;k<6;k++)c.lineTo(Math.sin(t*4+k)*6,30+k*9);c.stroke();for(let k=1;k<6;k+=2){c.fillStyle=k%4?'#2e86c1':'#f2c230';c.fillRect(Math.sin(t*4+k)*6-3,30+k*9-2,6,4)}c.restore()}
 function flag(c,x,y,t,wind){c.fillStyle='#4a4e56';c.fillRect(x-1,y-60,2,60);c.fillStyle='#2e86c1';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x+1,y-60);const w=wind;for(let k=0;k<=6;k++){const fx=x+1+k*5*(.35+w*.65),fy=y-60+k*.8*(1-w)*6+Math.sin(t*9+k)*w*2.5;c.lineTo(fx,fy)}for(let k=6;k>=0;k--){const fx=x+1+k*5*(.35+w*.65),fy=y-44+k*(1-w)*4+Math.sin(t*9+k)*w*2.5;c.lineTo(fx,fy)}c.closePath();c.fill()}
 function fireworks(c,t,list){c.save();c.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';for(const [t0,x,y,col] of list){const u=t-t0;if(u<0||u>2.2)continue;if(u<.5){c.fillStyle=K.rgba(col,.9);c.fillRect(x-1.5,y+200*(1-u/.5)-2,3,8);continue}const r=(u-.5)*130*(1-(u-.5)*.25),a=Math.max(0,1-(u-.5)/1.7);for(let k=0;k<26;k++){const an=k/26*TAU,px=x+Math.cos(an)*r,py=y+Math.sin(an)*r+(u-.5)*(u-.5)*30;c.fillStyle=K.rgba(col,a);c.beginPath();c.arc(px,py,2.4,0,TAU);c.fill()}K.glow(c,x,y,r*1.2,col,a*.25)}c.restore()}

 /* a shot of the real city: keys [[t,x,y,span],..] — the view moves inside a live buffer; a grade for the hour; a fallback when there is no game around */
 function shot(o){const cams={};const camOf=()=>{const k=innerWidth+'x'+innerHeight;return cams[k]||(cams[k]=TCCITY.camFor(o.keys,FW,FH,o.night))};
  const q={d:o.d,ch:o.ch,tr:o.tr,td:o.td,real:o.key,get cam(){return camOf()},draw(c,t,u){const [x,y,span]=K.kf(o.keys,t);let ok=false;try{ok=TCCITY.ok()&&TCCITY.view(c,o.key,camOf(),{x,y,span},FW,FH,66)}catch(e){}
   if(!ok){if(o.fallback)o.fallback(c,t,u);else{K.sky(c,0,0,FW,FH,o.hour||12,0)}}else grade(c,o.grade,t);if(o.over)o.over(c,t,u)}};return q}
 function grade(c,m,t){if(m==='night'){K.grade(c,FW,FH,'#1a2650',.66,'multiply');c.save();c.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';const R=K.rng(9);for(let i=0;i<26;i++){K.glow(c,R()*FW,R()*FH,30+R()*30,'#ffd98a',.12)}c.restore()}
  else if(m==='dusk'){K.grade(c,FW,FH,'#9a6a8a',.42,'multiply');K.grade(c,FW,FH,'#ff9a5a',.4,'soft-light')}else if(m==='dawn'){K.grade(c,FW,FH,'#b88a90',.3,'multiply');K.grade(c,FW,FH,'#ffc080',.45,'soft-light')}else if(m==='today'){K.grade(c,FW,FH,'#fff2d8',.18,'soft-light')}
  K.vignette(c,FW,FH,.4)}

function s15ObbHit(A,B){const [ax,ay,ah,al,aw]=A,[bx,by,bh,bl,bw]=B;if(Math.hypot(ax-bx,ay-by)>Math.hypot(al,aw)+Math.hypot(bl,bw))return false;for(const h of [ah,ah+Math.PI/2,bh,bh+Math.PI/2]){const c=Math.cos(h),s=Math.sin(h);
 const pr=(x,y,hh,l,w)=>{const p=x*c+y*s,r=Math.abs(l*(Math.cos(hh)*c+Math.sin(hh)*s))+Math.abs(w*(-Math.sin(hh)*c+Math.cos(hh)*s));return[p-r,p+r]};const [a0,a1]=pr(ax,ay,ah,al,aw),[b0,b1]=pr(bx,by,bh,bl,bw);if(a1<b0||b1<a0)return false}return true}
function s15Boxes(a,P){const [x,y,h,z]=P,c=Math.cos(h),s=Math.sin(h);if(a.kind==='ac'){if(z>30)return[];const ng=(S15SIM.ngf[a.model]||.12)*a.L;return[[x-c*(a.L/2-ng),y-s*(a.L/2-ng),h,a.L/2,a.L*.055+4],[x-c*(a.L*.45-ng),y-s*(a.L*.45-ng),h,a.L*.09,a.W/2]]}return[[x,y,h,a.L/2,a.W/2]]}
function s15SimAudit(dt=1){const T=S15SIM.T,issues=[],ALL=[...S15SIM.flights,...S15SIM.veh],R=S15D.rwy,RB=[(R[0]+R[2])/2,(R[1]+R[3])/2,0,(R[2]-R[0])/2,(R[3]-R[1])/2],act=new Set(S15SIM.sched.map(q=>q[0]));
 const PK=[];for(const [sid,ac] of Object.entries(S15D.parked)){if(!ac||act.has(sid))continue;const s=S15D.stands[sid],L=({'AC-LG-01':668,'AC-NB-01':376,'AC-RJ-01':317,'AC-CG-01':549,'AC-TB-01':120,'AC-LT-01':91,'AC-PR-01':83,'AC-BJ-01':144,'AC-CN-01':144})[ac]||300,Sp=({'AC-LG-01':648,'AC-NB-01':358,'AC-RJ-01':260,'AC-CG-01':476,'AC-TB-01':200,'AC-LT-01':112,'AC-PR-01':110,'AC-BJ-01':158,'AC-CN-01':140})[ac]||300;
  PK.push({id:'PK-'+sid,kind:'ac',model:ac,L,W:Sp,P:[s.cx,s.nose-(S15SIM.ngf[ac]||.12)*L,Math.PI/2,0]})}
 let pairs=0,ends=0;for(let t=0;t<T;t+=dt){const P=[];for(const a of ALL){const q=s15PoseAt(a,t);if(!q)continue;if(a.kind==='veh'&&q[4]===16)continue;const B=s15Boxes(a,q);if(a.kind==='veh'&&B.some(b=>s15ObbHit(b,RB)))issues.push(t+': '+a.id+' על המסלול');P.push([a,B,q])}
  for(const p of PK)P.push([p,s15Boxes(p,p.P),p.P]);
  for(let i=0;i<P.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<P.length;j++){const [a,A,qa]=P[i],[b,B,qb]=P[j];if(a.kind==='veh'&&b.kind==='veh'&&a.home===b.home&&qa[4]===0&&qb[4]===0)continue;pairs++;if(A.some(x=>B.some(y=>s15ObbHit(x,y)))){issues.push(t+': '+a.id+' × '+b.id);if(issues.length>30)return{ok:false,issues,pairs}}}}
 for(const a of S15SIM.flights){const xs=a.legs.flatMap(g=>g.p.map(p=>p[0]));if(Math.min(...xs)<0&&Math.max(...xs)>9600)ends++}
 return{ok:!issues.length&&ends===S15SIM.flights.length,issues,pairs,cycles:ends}}
/* כמו vinv (שמדלג על אזורי השדה — VINV.AIRPORT): אף רכב לא מופיע או נעלם, ואף אחד לא קופץ; מטוס — רק מעבר לקצה העולם */
function s15VinvAudit(){const T=S15SIM.T,dt=.5,issues=[];let a=0;
 for(const v of S15SIM.veh){let p=null;for(let t=0;t<=T;t+=dt){const q=s15PoseAt(v,t%T);if(!q){issues.push(v.id+' לא מצויר ב-'+t);break}if(p){const d=Math.hypot(q[0]-p[0],q[1]-p[1]);if(d>90){issues.push(v.id+' קופץ '+Math.round(d)+' ב-'+t);break}}p=q}}
 for(const f of S15SIM.flights){a++;let p=null;for(let t=0;t<=T;t+=dt){const q=s15PoseAt(f,t%T);if(!!q!==!!p&&t>0){const r=q||p;if(r[0]>=0&&r[0]<=9600){issues.push(f.id+(q?' מופיע':' נעלם')+' ב-'+Math.round(r[0])+','+Math.round(r[1]));break}}if(q&&p){const d=Math.hypot(q[0]-p[0],q[1]-p[1]);if(d>420){issues.push(f.id+' קופץ '+Math.round(d));break}}p=q}}
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues,n:S15SIM.veh.length,a}}
/* D‑650 · המחזור של המטוס, בתוך המשחק (אותה s15PoseLeg שמציירת, כל 0.1 ש׳): הסטייה מהקו האמצעי של המסלול בגלגול (נחיתה והמראה) ובאוויר
   (הגישה והטיפוס), נקודת ההינתקות, הכיוון על המסלול (09 — מזרחה), הסטייה מהקו של A בישרים, וזווית הסיבוב הרציף הגדולה ביותר
   (סיבוב "נגמר" אחרי 40 פיקס׳ בקו ישר או כשהכיוון מתהפך) — בלי 360, בלי פרסה, בלי היפוך פתאומי של האף */
function s15CycleAudit(dt=.1){const R=S15D.rwy,RC=S15D.rcy,TY=S15D.tacy,issues=[],per=[];let W={rwy:0,air:0,twa:0,turn:0,jump:0};
 for(const a of S15SIM.flights){const L=a.legs.filter(g=>!g.att);if(!L.length)continue;const t0=L[0].t0,t1=L[L.length-1].t1;
  let p=null,acc=0,sg=0,sd=0,mx=0,mxAt=null,dR=0,dAir=0,dA=0,lift=null,jump=0,west=0;
  for(let t=t0;t<=t1+1e-9;t+=dt){let q=null;for(const g of L)if(t>=g.t0-1e-6&&t<=g.t1+1e-6){q=s15PoseLeg(g,t);break}if(!q){p=null;continue}
   const [x,y,h,z]=q,inR=z<=2&&x>=R[0]&&x<=R[2]&&y>=R[1]&&y<=R[3],st=Math.abs(Math.sin(h))<.035;
   if(p){const ds=Math.hypot(x-p[0],y-p[1]),v=ds/dt,dh=Math.atan2(Math.sin(h-p[2]),Math.cos(h-p[2]));
    if(v>.5){if(Math.abs(dh)>Math.PI/6)jump=Math.max(jump,Math.abs(dh));
     if(Math.abs(dh)<1e-4){sd+=ds;if(sd>40){acc=0;sg=0}}else{const s=Math.sign(dh);if(s!==sg){acc=0;sg=s}acc+=dh;sd=0;if(Math.abs(acc)>mx){mx=Math.abs(acc);mxAt=[Math.round(x),Math.round(y)]}}
     if(inR&&st&&v>30){dR=Math.max(dR,Math.abs(y-RC));if(Math.cos(h)<0)west++}
     if(!inR&&z<=2&&st&&v>5&&Math.abs(y-TY)<60&&x>R[0]&&x<R[2])dA=Math.max(dA,Math.abs(y-TY))}
    if(z>2&&z<=600&&x>-200&&x<9800)dAir=Math.max(dAir,Math.abs(y-RC));
    if(p[3]<=2&&z>2&&lift==null)lift=[Math.round(x),Math.round(y-RC)]}
   p=[x,y,h,z]}
  const T=Math.round(mx*180/Math.PI),J=Math.round(jump*180/Math.PI);per.push({id:a.id,ac:a.model,rwy:+dR.toFixed(1),air:+dAir.toFixed(1),twa:+dA.toFixed(1),lift,turn:T,turnAt:mxAt,jump:J,west});
  W.rwy=Math.max(W.rwy,dR);W.air=Math.max(W.air,dAir);W.twa=Math.max(W.twa,dA);W.turn=Math.max(W.turn,T);W.jump=Math.max(W.jump,J);
  if(dR>3)issues.push(a.id+' סוטה '+dR.toFixed(1)+' פיקס׳ מהקו האמצעי בגלגול');if(dAir>3)issues.push(a.id+' סוטה '+dAir.toFixed(1)+' באוויר');if(!lift||Math.abs(lift[1])>3)issues.push(a.id+' מתנתק '+(lift?lift[1]+' פיקס׳ מהקו האמצעי':'— אין המראה'));
  if(west)issues.push(a.id+' נוסע על המסלול מערבה ('+west+' דגימות)');if(T>185)issues.push(a.id+' מסתובב '+T+'° ברצף ב-'+mxAt);if(J>0)issues.push(a.id+' האף מתהפך '+J+'° בבת אחת');if(dA>3)issues.push(a.id+' סוטה '+dA.toFixed(1)+' מהקו של A')}
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues,worst:{rwy:+W.rwy.toFixed(1),air:+W.air.toFixed(1),twa:+W.twa.toFixed(1),turn:W.turn,jump:W.jump},per}}

function s15gRound(W,R){const out=[[W[0][0],W[0][1]]];for(let i=1;i<W.length-1;i++){const a=W[i-1],b=W[i],c=W[i+1],d1=[b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1]],d2=[c[0]-b[0],c[1]-b[1]],l1=Math.hypot(d1[0],d1[1]),l2=Math.hypot(d2[0],d2[1]);
  if(l1<1e-6||l2<1e-6)continue;const u1=[d1[0]/l1,d1[1]/l1],u2=[d2[0]/l2,d2[1]/l2],ang=Math.atan2(u1[0]*u2[1]-u1[1]*u2[0],u1[0]*u2[0]+u1[1]*u2[1]);if(Math.abs(ang)<1e-3){out.push([b[0],b[1]]);continue}
  const tl0=Math.min(R*Math.tan(Math.abs(ang)/2),(i===1?l1:l1/2),(i===W.length-2?l2:l2/2)),r=tl0/Math.tan(Math.abs(ang)/2),p0=[b[0]-u1[0]*tl0,b[1]-u1[1]*tl0],sg=Math.sign(ang),cx=p0[0]-sg*r*u1[1],cy=p0[1]+sg*r*u1[0],n=Math.max(2,Math.ceil(Math.abs(ang)/(Math.PI/2)*8));
  for(let k=0;k<=n;k++){const t=ang*k/n,vx=p0[0]-cx,vy=p0[1]-cy;out.push([cx+vx*Math.cos(t)-vy*Math.sin(t),cy+vx*Math.sin(t)+vy*Math.cos(t)])}}
 out.push([W[W.length-1][0],W[W.length-1][1]]);return out.map(q=>[+q[0].toFixed(1),+q[1].toFixed(1)])}

// רגל נסיעה שמסתיימת בזמן te (אחורה מהזמן)

function s15iRound(P,r){if(P.length<3)return P;const out=[P[0]];for(let i=1;i<P.length-1;i++){const a=P[i-1],b=P[i],c=P[i+1],l1=Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1]),l2=Math.hypot(c[0]-b[0],c[1]-b[1]);
  const t1=Math.atan2(b[1]-a[1],b[0]-a[0]),t2=Math.atan2(c[1]-b[1],c[0]-b[0]),dt=Math.atan2(Math.sin(t2-t1),Math.cos(t2-t1));if(Math.abs(dt)<.05||l1<2||l2<2){out.push(b);continue}
  const k=Math.min(r*Math.tan(Math.abs(dt)/2),l1*.45,l2*.45),p0=[b[0]-Math.cos(t1)*k,b[1]-Math.sin(t1)*k],p1=[b[0]+Math.cos(t2)*k,b[1]+Math.sin(t2)*k],n=Math.max(2,Math.ceil(Math.abs(dt)/.35));
  for(let j=0;j<=n;j++){const u=j/n,m=[(1-u)*(1-u)*p0[0]+2*u*(1-u)*b[0]+u*u*p1[0],(1-u)*(1-u)*p0[1]+2*u*(1-u)*b[1]+u*u*p1[1]];out.push(m)}}
 out.push(P[P.length-1]);return out.map(p=>[+p[0].toFixed(1),+p[1].toFixed(1)])}
// המהירויות של רגל לפי האורך החדש (אותו זמן): s15PoseLeg — המרחק = (v0+v1)/2 × הזמן
function s15iFit(g){const T=g.t1-g.t0,L=s15iLen(g.p),L0=(g.v0+g.v1)/2*T;if(L0>1e-6&&T>1e-6){const k=L/L0;g.v0*=k;g.v1*=k}}
// רגל ההגעה / השירות / היציאה של ביקור אחד → נקודה חדשה Q = [x, y, h]. הגישה: מהכביש (הנקודה של הקו הישן שהכי קרובה ל-Ld) → Ld (lead פיקס׳
// לפני Q, בכיוון h) → Q; היציאה: back — לאחור עד Ld (המסוע — "straight back along it" כמו בישן), ואז אל הקו הישן; בלי back — ישר מ-Q אל הקו הישן
function s15iRetarget(v,j,Q,lead,back,xo){xo=xo||0;const L=v.legs,A=L[j-1],S=L[j],R=L[j+1];if(!A||!S||!R||A.h!=null||R.h!=null||A.att||R.att)return false;

 const yR=R.p[Math.min(2,R.p.length-1)][1],Lr2=[M[0],Math.max(M[1],yR)],nR=s15iNear(R.p,Lr2[0],Lr2[1]),rest=[nR.q].concat(R.p.slice(nR.i+1)),mid=[];for(const q of [M,Lr2])if(Math.hypot(q[0]-(mid.length?mid[mid.length-1]:Ld)[0],q[1]-(mid.length?mid[mid.length-1]:Ld)[1])>1)mid.push(q);

  const B={p:[[Q[0],Q[1]],Ld],t0:R.t0,t1,v0:0,v1:0,r:1,z0:0,z1:0,f:1};B.v0=B.v1=l1/Math.max(.1,t1-R.t0);

 else{R.p=s15iRound([[Q[0],Q[1]]].concat(mid.length?mid:[Lr2],rest),9);s15iFit(R)}

// המסוע בישן (046:322): "up its column from the road, into the 60° line; out: straight back along it, back down the column" — כאן: מהכביש צפונה בעמודה,
// קשת ברדיוס r אל הקו של המסוע (60° לגוף) ועצירה בדלת; ביציאה — לאחור באותה קשת ובעמודה עד הכביש, ומשם קדימה. r נבחר כך שהעמודה לא עוברת בכיס חונה
function s15iArcPts(Q,h0,r,n){const h1=Q[2],k=n||8,pts=[];for(let i=0;i<=k;i++){const h=h0+(h1-h0)*i/k;pts.push([Q[0]-r*(Math.sin(h1)-Math.sin(h)),Q[1]-r*(Math.cos(h)-Math.cos(h1))])}return pts}
function s15iRetargetArc(v,j,Q,r){const L=v.legs,A=L[j-1],S=L[j],R=L[j+1];if(!A||!S||!R||A.h!=null||R.h!=null||A.att||R.att)return false;const h0=-Math.PI/2;

 const B={p:bp,t0:R.t0,t1,v0:0,v1:0,r:1,z0:0,z1:0,f:1};B.v0=B.v1=l1/Math.max(.1,t1-R.t0);const F=Object.assign({},R,{p:s15iRound([Lr2].concat(rest),9),t0:t1});s15iFit(F);L.splice(j+1,1,B,F);return true}
// הבדיקה של S15 (s15SimAudit) לרכב אחד בחלון זמן: כמה פעמים הקופסאות שלו נוגעות ברכב / מטוס אחר (כל 0.5 ש׳) — כדי לבחור את הנתיב בין החונים
function s15iHits(v,t0,t1){const T=S15SIM.T,ALL=[...S15SIM.flights,...S15SIM.veh].filter(a=>a!==v),act=new Set(S15SIM.sched.map(q=>q[0])),PK=[];let n=0;
 for(const [sid,ac] of Object.entries(S15D.parked)){if(!ac||act.has(sid))continue;const st=S15D.stands[sid],L=({'AC-LG-01':668,'AC-NB-01':376,'AC-RJ-01':317,'AC-CG-01':549,'AC-TB-01':120,'AC-LT-01':91,'AC-PR-01':83,'AC-BJ-01':144,'AC-CN-01':144})[ac]||300,Sp=({'AC-LG-01':648,'AC-NB-01':358,'AC-RJ-01':260,'AC-CG-01':476,'AC-TB-01':200,'AC-LT-01':112,'AC-PR-01':110,'AC-BJ-01':158,'AC-CN-01':140})[ac]||300;
  PK.push(s15Boxes({kind:'ac',model:ac,L,W:Sp},[st.cx,st.nose-(S15SIM.ngf[ac]||.12)*L,Math.PI/2,0]))}

  for(const a of ALL){const p=s15PoseAt(a,tc);if(!p||(a.kind==='veh'&&p[4]===16))continue;if(a.kind==='veh'&&a.home===v.home&&p[4]===0&&q[4]===0)continue;const C=s15Boxes(a,p);if(B.some(x=>C.some(y=>s15ObbHit(x,y)))){n++;break}}
  for(const C of PK)if(B.some(x=>C.some(y=>s15ObbHit(x,y)))){n++;break}}

function s15iHits1(v){const A=v.legs.find(g=>g.f===1),Z=v.legs.slice().reverse().find(g=>g.f===1);if(!A||!Z)return 0;let n=0;const T=S15SIM.T;for(let t=Math.ceil(A.t0);t<=Z.t1;t+=1){const st=s15iHitsAt(v,((t%T)+T)%T);if(st)n++}return n}
function s15iHitsAt(v,tc){const q=s15PoseAt(v,tc);if(!q)return 0;const B=s15Boxes(v,q);for(const a of [...S15SIM.flights,...S15SIM.veh]){if(a===v)continue;const p=s15PoseAt(a,tc);if(!p||(a.kind==='veh'&&p[4]===16))continue;if(a.kind==='veh'&&a.home===v.home&&p[4]===0&&q[4]===0)continue;if(B.some(x=>s15Boxes(a,p).some(y=>s15ObbHit(x,y))))return 1}return 0}

function s15kSat(A,H,B){// A — מלבן שנמשך למעלה ב-H (פיקס׳ מסך), B — מלבן; העומק הקטן של החפיפה (≤ 0 — אין)

  const pa=A.x*ux+A.y*uy,pb=B.x*ux+B.y*uy,e=-H*uy,a0=pa-rA+Math.min(0,e),a1=pa+rA+Math.max(0,e),b0=pb-rB,b1=pb+rB,o=Math.min(a1,b1)-Math.max(a0,b0);if(o<dmin)dmin=o;if(dmin<=0)return dmin}return dmin}

function s15jPlan(){if(S15J.plan)return S15J.plan;if(S15J.planTry>40)return null;if(S15J.planNext&&performance.now()<S15J.planNext)return null;S15J.planTry++;S15J.planNext=performance.now()+1500;

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- המקום של סוכן ברגע t ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function s15jAt(a,tc){const T=S15SIM.T;let s=((tc-a.t0)%T+T)%T;if(a.loop)s=s%a.dur;else if(s>=a.dur)return null;
 let i=0;const C=a.cum;let lo=0,hi=C.length-1;while(lo<hi){const m=(lo+hi+1)>>1;if(C[m]<=s)lo=m;else hi=m-1}i=lo;const g=a.legs[i],u=s-C[i];
 let x,y,z,h,act,lk=g.lk,ph=0;
 if(g.k==='d'){[x,y,z]=g.p;h=g.h;act=g.act}else{const d=Math.min(g.L,u*g.L/Math.max(.001,g.dur));let k=1;while(k<g.cum.length-1&&g.cum[k]<d)k++;const a0=g.P[k-1],b=g.P[k],L=g.cum[k]-g.cum[k-1]||1,f=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(d-g.cum[k-1])/L));
  x=a0[0]+(b[0]-a0[0])*f;y=a0[1]+(b[1]-a0[1])*f;z=a0[2]+(b[2]-a0[2])*f;h=Math.atan2(b[1]-a0[1],b[0]-a0[0]);act=g.act==='ride'?'stand':'walk';ph=(d/9)%1}
 let al=1;if(a.fadeIn&&s<a.fadeIn)al=s/a.fadeIn;if(a.fadeOut&&a.dur-s<a.fadeOut)al=Math.min(al,(a.dur-s)/a.fadeOut);
 return{x,y,z:z||0,h,act,lk,ph,al:Math.max(0,al),tool:g.tool,leg:i,s,bag:g.bag}}

const S15J_MAT={stone:['#ebe6dc','#4d4a43'],carpet:['#8196ae','#3a465a'],carpet2:['#9b97b0','#47435a'],tile:['#e8eef0','#48545b'],service:['#a9acae','#3e3f40'],mat:['#8a9196','#3a4044'],dfree:['#f3e9d6','#57493a'],food:['#e6d2b0','#59493a'],shopfl:['#f1ece3','#4f4a41'],wood:['#c79c6d','#5b4430'],play:['#f5d77a','#5e5330']};
function s15jPrism(g,x0,y0,x1,y1,h,top,front,line){const H=s15jK()*h*10;g.fillStyle=front;g.fillRect(x0,y1-H,x1-x0,H);g.fillStyle=top;g.fillRect(x0,y0-H,x1-x0,y1-y0);if(line){g.strokeStyle=line;g.lineWidth=.5;g.strokeRect(x0+.25,y0-H+.25,x1-x0-.5,y1-y0-.5)}}
function s15jFloor(g,r,mat,N){const C=S15J_MAT[mat]||S15J_MAT.stone,c=N?C[1]:C[0];g.fillStyle=c;g.fillRect(r[0],r[1],r[2]-r[0],r[3]-r[1]);g.save();g.beginPath();g.rect(r[0],r[1],r[2]-r[0],r[3]-r[1]);g.clip();
 if(mat==='stone'){g.strokeStyle=N?'rgba(0,0,0,.18)':'rgba(150,138,116,.22)';g.lineWidth=.5;g.beginPath();for(let x=Math.ceil(r[0]/20)*20;x<r[2];x+=20){g.moveTo(x,r[1]);g.lineTo(x,r[3])}for(let y=Math.ceil(r[1]/20)*20;y<r[3];y+=20){g.moveTo(r[0],y);g.lineTo(r[2],y)}g.stroke();
  g.fillStyle=N?'rgba(255,230,180,.03)':'rgba(255,255,255,.18)';for(let x=Math.ceil(r[0]/80)*80;x<r[2];x+=80){g.beginPath();g.moveTo(x,r[1]);g.lineTo(x+18,r[1]);g.lineTo(x-30,r[3]);g.lineTo(x-48,r[3]);g.fill()}}
 else if(mat==='carpet'||mat==='carpet2'){g.fillStyle=N?'rgba(255,255,255,.04)':'rgba(255,255,255,.12)';for(let x=r[0]+2;x<r[2];x+=6)for(let y=r[1]+2+((x/6)%2)*3;y<r[3];y+=6)g.fillRect(x,y,1,1)}
 else if(mat==='tile'){g.strokeStyle=N?'rgba(0,0,0,.25)':'rgba(120,150,160,.3)';g.lineWidth=.4;g.beginPath();for(let x=r[0];x<r[2];x+=6){g.moveTo(x,r[1]);g.lineTo(x,r[3])}for(let y=r[1];y<r[3];y+=6){g.moveTo(r[0],y);g.lineTo(r[2],y)}g.stroke()}
 else if(mat==='food'){g.fillStyle=N?'rgba(0,0,0,.12)':'rgba(150,110,60,.12)';for(let x=r[0];x<r[2];x+=12)for(let y=r[1];y<r[3];y+=12)if(((x-r[0])/12+(y-r[1])/12)%2<1)g.fillRect(x,y,12,12)}
 else if(mat==='wood'){g.strokeStyle=N?'rgba(0,0,0,.25)':'rgba(110,70,30,.28)';g.lineWidth=.5;g.beginPath();for(let y=r[1];y<r[3];y+=4){g.moveTo(r[0],y);g.lineTo(r[2],y)}g.stroke()}
 else if(mat==='mat'){g.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.08)';g.lineWidth=.6;g.beginPath();for(let x=r[0];x<r[2];x+=2.5){g.moveTo(x,r[1]);g.lineTo(x,r[3])}g.stroke()}
 else if(mat==='dfree'){g.fillStyle=N?'rgba(0,0,0,.2)':'rgba(120,90,40,.12)';g.fillRect(r[0],(r[1]+r[3])/2-4,r[2]-r[0],8)}
